plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: MapMyTrip records your route while journeys are active, including in the background.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MapMyTrip uses your location to show your path on the map.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow background location so MapMyTrip can continue recording your journey when the screen is off.

plugins.microphonePermission: MapMyTrip needs the microphone to record voice notes on a journey.

plugins.photosPermission: MapMyTrip needs access to your photos to attach images to a journey.
plugins.cameraPermission: MapMyTrip can use the camera to capture images for a journey.
